description: Land Title Registration Department - :Amendment to the Gaz.Ex.No. 1758/07, D/S Division, Homagama - C. M. No. 520006 and Other amendments
reasoning: This gazette content deals exclusively with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act, specifically addressing servitude rights and access rights for various parcels of land in different locations. The content focuses on land property matters, cadastral maps, and title settlements, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
